key: TAKA: Given that room upstairs, I was expecting a Garchompite.
en: TAKA: Given that room upstairs, I was expecting a Garchompite.
ja: タカ: 上の部屋を　見た感じ　ガブリアスナイトを　期待してたんですけどね。

key: Then again, there's no way my father wouldn't have that...
en: Then again, there's no way my father wouldn't have that...
ja: まあ　父が　あれを　持ってないなんて　ことは　ないでしょうし……

key: Stray crumbs rest in the stone basin.
en: Stray crumbs rest in the stone basin.
ja: 石の水盤に　パンくずが　残っている。

key: Refill the basin with some PokéSnax?
en: Refill the basin with some PokéSnax?
ja: ポケスナックを　水盤に　補充しますか?

key: All full!
en: All full!
ja: 満タンだ!

key: TAKA: Seems like there's just crumbs left here...
en: TAKA: Seems like there's just crumbs left here...
ja: タカ: ここには　くずしか　残ってないみたいですね……

key: TAKA: If we're talking about an offering, these basins are probably where it was left.
en: TAKA: If we're talking about an offering, these basins are probably where it was left.
ja: タカ: お供え物　というなら　この水盤が　置き場所だったんでしょう。

key: There seem to be a lot of them... I wonder if this was a place for many more people in the past.
en: There seem to be a lot of them... I wonder if this was a place for many more people in the past.
ja: ずいぶん　たくさん　ありますね……　昔は　もっと多くの人のための　場所だったんでしょうか。

key: My father said our family used to be much larger and much more influential.
en: My father said our family used to be much larger and much more influential.
ja: 父が　言うには　昔は　うちの一族は　もっと大きくて　もっと　影響力が　あったそうです。

key: Falling into decline is just the way of the world.
en: Falling into decline is just the way of the world.
ja: 衰退していくのは　世の常ってやつですね。

key: Anyway, if you happen to have anything Pokémon might like, try putting it there.
en: Anyway, if you happen to have anything Pokémon might like, try putting it there.
ja: とにかく　ポケモンが　好きそうなものを　持ってたら　そこに　置いてみてください。

key: TAKA: That should be enough. Hopefully something will come by for it.
en: TAKA: That should be enough. Hopefully something will come by for it.
ja: タカ: これで　十分でしょう。何か　来てくれると　いいですね。

key: The basin is stuffed with food now.
en: The basin is stuffed with food now.
ja: 水盤には　今　食べ物が　いっぱいに　なっている。

key: TAKA: This one's full up.
en: TAKA: This one's full up.
ja: タカ: これは　もう　満杯です。

key: We might have to make ourselves scarce if we want something to come for it though.
en: We might have to make ourselves scarce if we want something to come for it though.
ja: でも　何か　来てほしいなら　しばらく　姿を　消したほうが　いいかもしれません。

key: Refill the basin with some Pokesnax?
en: Refill the basin with some Pokesnax?
ja: ポケスナックを　水盤に　補充しますか?

key: TAKA: What, it ran off already?
en: TAKA: What, it ran off already?
ja: タカ: え　もう　逃げちゃったんですか?

key: That one's pretty skittish, huh...
en: That one's pretty skittish, huh...
ja: あいつ　かなり　臆病なんですね……

key: TAKA: Again? We weren't even that close.
en: TAKA: Again? We weren't even that close.
ja: タカ: また? そんなに　近づいてすら　いなかったのに。

key: And was it even looking?
en: And was it even looking?
ja: というか　こっち　見てすら　いました?

key: TAKA: This is starting to feel hopeless.
en: TAKA: This is starting to feel hopeless.
ja: タカ: だんだん　絶望的な　気が　してきました。

key: TAKA: I'd say something like, let's split up and corner it between us, but as long as it can go underground, I don't think it'd make a difference.
en: TAKA: I'd say something like, let's split up and corner it between us, but as long as it can go underground, I don't think it'd make a difference.
ja: タカ: 手分けして　挟み撃ちに　とも思いますが　地中に　もぐれる以上　あまり　意味は　なさそうです。

key: TAKA: Maybe there's some other way we can get a jump on it and surprise it?
en: TAKA: Maybe there's some other way we can get a jump on it and surprise it?
ja: タカ: 何か他に　不意を突く方法が　あるんじゃ　ないでしょうか?

key: TAKA: This one's in pretty good condition... except for the inscription.
en: TAKA: This one's in pretty good condition... except for the inscription.
ja: タカ: これは　わりと　状態が　いいですね……　碑文以外は。

key: Yeah, I got nothing.
en: Yeah, I got nothing.
ja: ええ　まったく　わかりません。

key: TAKA: This says something about... a "tradition of honor"?
en: TAKA: This says something about... a "tradition of honor"?
ja: タカ: これには……「名誉の伝統」とかいう　ことが　書いてある気が　します?

key: ...No wonder my father always said such boring things.
en: ...No wonder my father always said such boring things.
ja: ……道理で　父は　いつも　あんな退屈なこと　言ってたわけですね。

key: TAKA: There was somewhere below there too...
en: TAKA: There was somewhere below there too...
ja: タカ: この下にも　どこか　あった気が……

key: Oh, I remember!
en: Oh, I remember!
ja: ああ　思い出しました!

key: This is where my father met his Garchomp!
en: This is where my father met his Garchomp!
ja: ここが　父が　自分のガブリアスと　出会った場所です!

key: Well-- it was just a Gible at the time.
en: Well-- it was just a Gible at the time.
ja: まあ――　当時は　ただの　フカマルでしたけど。

key: And--
en: And--
ja: それで――

key: Oh...
en: Oh...
ja: トロイ: ああ……

key: I had forgotten... he tried to get one for me too.
en: I had forgotten... he tried to get one for me too.
ja: 忘れてました……　父は　僕にも　一体　取ってやろうと　したんです。

key: But I didn't want it.
en: But I didn't want it.
ja: でも　僕は　欲しく　ありませんでした。

key: I don't remember why.
en: I don't remember why.
ja: なぜだったかは　覚えてません。

key: When we left, he said that I ruined the whole trip by not catching one...
en: When we left, he said that I ruined the whole trip by not catching one...
ja: 帰るとき　父は　僕が　捕まえなかったせいで　旅行が　台無しだと　言いました……

key: So much for a positive memory. I forgot about that entirely.
en: So much for a positive memory. I forgot about that entirely.
ja: 良い思い出も　台無しですね。すっかり　忘れてました。

key: Maybe I should've just gone with it even though I didn't want to.
en: Maybe I should've just gone with it even though I didn't want to.
ja: 欲しくなくても　言うとおりに　しておけば　よかったのかもしれません。

key: I was just a kid. I probably didn't have much of a reason.
en: I was just a kid. I probably didn't have much of a reason.
ja: ただの子どもでしたから。たいした理由なんて　なかったんでしょう。

key: ...But then again, maybe refusing to take the Pokémon left for me by our bloodline was just proof that I'd eventually leave them and come here with you.
en: ...But then again, maybe refusing to take the Pokémon left for me by our bloodline was just proof that I'd eventually leave them and come here with you.
ja: ……でも　考えてみれば　一族が　僕に残したポケモンを　拒んだのは　いずれ　彼らを　離れて　あなたと　ここへ来ることに　なる　証だったのかもしれません。

key: So I still don't want it.
en: So I still don't want it.
ja: だから　今も　やっぱり　欲しくないんです。

key: But, if you want to look for a Pokémon like that, I'll support you.
en: But, if you want to look for a Pokémon like that, I'll support you.
ja: でも　あなたが　あんなポケモンを　探したいなら　僕は　応援します。

key: I think it may not come out through normal means...
en: I think it may not come out through normal means...
ja: 普通のやり方じゃ　出てこないと　思いますが……

key: I remember something about having to leave an offering and then coming back later...
en: I remember something about having to leave an offering and then coming back later...
ja: お供え物を　置いて　あとで　戻ってこなきゃ　いけなかった気が　します……

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
